// Generator of go-case.json: the runes that Go's strings.ToUpper and
// strings.ToLower change, with the toolchain of the freeze commit. Kept as
// text; regenerate with: cp go-case.go.txt /tmp/x/main.go && go run /tmp/x/main.go > go-case.json
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"unicode/utf8"
)

func main() {
	changed := [][3]int{}
	for r := rune(0); r <= 0x10FFFF; r++ {
		if r >= 0xD800 && r <= 0xDFFF {
			continue
		}
		s := string(r)
		up, low := strings.ToUpper(s), strings.ToLower(s)
		if up == s && low == s {
			continue
		}
		u, _ := utf8.DecodeRuneInString(up)
		l, _ := utf8.DecodeRuneInString(low)
		changed = append(changed, [3]int{int(r), int(u), int(l)})
	}
	out := map[string]any{
		"recordedFrom": "Go 1.27.3 standard library, the toolchain of the freeze commit 238e07f66d8cafab24ef363cb79e207bd48babd8",
		"changed":      changed,
	}
	data, _ := json.Marshal(out)
	os.Stdout.Write(append(data, '\n'))
}
